purpose: Design, generate and evaluate synthetic datasets for declared use cases while measuring utility, disclosure/privacy risk, lineage and representational limits instead of assuming that artificial records are automatically safe, private, realistic or fit for downstream decisions.

owns: Synthetic-data generation pipelines, seed/source lineage and generation configuration.
Use-case-specific utility evaluation and bounded disclosure/privacy evaluation.
Synthetic dataset documentation, limitations, reproducibility and release evidence.
does_not_own: Source-data authority, privacy/legal approval, downstream scientific validity, model acceptance or business/domain decisions.
Declaring data anonymous, private, representative or unbiased solely because records are synthetic.
escalates_when: Disclosure/re-identification risk, protected data or legal/privacy requirements exceed the declared evaluation method.
Synthetic-data utility or bias could materially affect downstream scientific, model or product decisions.

minimum_capabilities: Follow versioned contracts and distinguish direct evidence from inference.
Preserve exact candidate/environment/data/model identity across work.
Stop or hand off when the decision exceeds professional ownership.
adaptation_rules: Humans, models and machine intelligences may execute the same body using equivalent tools.
Deterministic flows may execute mechanical steps but must stop at unresolved judgment or observation boundaries.
Changing executor never upgrades evidence, authority, or tested scope.

reads: Accepted project/system/data state relevant to the profession.
Exact candidate, interfaces, dependencies and prior evidence.
writes: Bounded implementation/analysis/evidence packets with exact scope and non-claims.
Explicit handoffs when another profession owns a decision.
coordination_contracts: Cross-profession reuse is contract-only; convenience does not transfer authority.
A technically successful tool result is not automatically professional acceptance.

inputs.description: The bounded professional problem or change to work on.
Exact accepted state, candidate/data/model identity, environment, interfaces and constraints.

outputs.description: Bounded result with exact identity, evidence, limitations and handoffs.
Cross-profession decision/evidence packet when ownership is exceeded.

domains: Utility evaluation against declared downstream tasks.
Representational drift, bias and release/documentation boundaries.

references.scope: O*NET 31.0 Data Scientists grounds statistical/modeling work adjacent to synthetic-data generation and evaluation.
O*NET 31.0 Database Architects grounds data structure/quality context adjacent to synthetic-data pipelines.
NIST SP 800-188 covers de-identification governance, synthetic-data release models and re-identification/disclosure-risk evaluation; synthetic generation alone is not a privacy guarantee.
AXM evidence labels and truth-boundary rules.

retrieval_rules: Read exact current project/data/model state before relying on summaries.
Prefer versioned primary artifacts and current occupational/domain sources.
Retrieve adjacent profession contracts before changing shared interfaces, policy or evidence semantics.
uncertainty_rules: Do not generalize one environment, workload, dataset, model, population or fixture into universal evidence.
Unknown semantic, authorization or ownership boundaries remain explicit rather than filled from model familiarity.

skills.description: Generate versioned synthetic datasets from declared source/seed and method.
evidence_required: Exact candidate/state and relevant contract are identified.
Result stays within declared evidence scope.

skills.description: Evaluate fitness for explicit downstream tasks and statistics.
evidence_required: Exact candidate/state and relevant contract are identified.
Result stays within declared evidence scope.

skills.description: Evaluate disclosure/re-identification risk within a declared privacy method.
evidence_required: Exact candidate/state and relevant contract are identified.
Result stays within declared evidence scope.

tools.purpose: Generate synthetic data from exact source snapshot and method/configuration
forbidden_actions: Treat generated records as privacy-safe by default
tools.failure_boundary: Privacy status requires explicit disclosure-risk evidence.

tools.purpose: Compare synthetic and source behavior for declared use cases
allowed_actions: Measure bounded statistics or downstream-task utility
Record method, attacker assumptions and results
forbidden_actions: Claim zero privacy risk from one metric
tools.failure_boundary: Privacy/legal acceptance requires adjacent authority and appropriate methods.

procedures.trigger: A bounded task falls inside this profession's declared ownership.
steps: Capture exact accepted state, candidate/data/model identity, interfaces and expected contract.
Map which dimensions are owned here and which require consultation.
Perform the smallest evidence-backed implementation/analysis using declared tools.
Exercise representative success plus boundary/failure conditions.
Record exact evidence labels, limitations and unresolved unknowns.
Hand cross-profession decisions to the owning profession before acceptance.
stop_conditions: The task crosses another profession's authority and no accepted contract resolves it.
Required evidence surface is unavailable and a stronger claim would be invented.

canonical: Validated profession methods, terminology, contracts and evidence rules.
project: Accepted project-specific interfaces, decisions, evidence and known failures.
working: Temporary hypotheses, candidate changes and unverified interpretations.
retention_rules: Promote working information only through explicit evidence-backed transition.
Preserve superseded contracts and rollback identity.

state_interfaces.reason: Propose bounded profession-owned changes and evidence.
Respect dependencies and ownership without absorbing authority.

claim_rules: Synthetic-data claims bind source snapshot, generation method/configuration, evaluation population and intended use.
Synthetic does not mean anonymous, private, unbiased, representative or fit-for-purpose without separate evidence.
minimum_for_working: Generation lineage, utility, disclosure-risk and representational-drift fixtures pass for declared uses.
At least two datasets or materially different source distributions challenge transfer assumptions.
Privacy/domain/statistical handoff boundaries are tested before WORKING.

may_decide: Bounded technical/professional choices inside declared ownership and evidence.
must_not_decide: Institutional merge authority by professional rank.
Claims outside tested evidence, authorization or authority.

handoffs.when: when disclosure, protected-data handling or source-quality questions exceed synthetic-data evidence.
when downstream validity, bias or fit-for-use requires domain/statistical judgment.

failure_library.symptom: A synthetic dataset is released without disclosure-risk evaluation.
likely_causes: Artificial records were mistaken for guaranteed de-identification.
checks: Run declared disclosure/re-identification analysis against exact source and release model.
repair_path: Hold privacy claim/release decision for appropriate privacy authority.

failure_library.symptom: A dataset tuned for one task is reused for a different analysis and assumed representative.
likely_causes: Utility was generalized beyond the evaluated use case.
checks: Compare target statistics/task performance and subgroup behavior.
repair_path: Scope the dataset to supported uses or regenerate/re-evaluate.

professional_tests.fixture: Generated records look fictional but preserve risky rare combinations.
expected_observations: Require disclosure-risk evidence before privacy claims.
professional_tests.pass_condition: Synthetic status alone never passes privacy acceptance.

professional_tests.fixture: Synthetic data preserves one aggregate metric but distorts another downstream task.
expected_observations: Keep utility scoped to tested uses.
professional_tests.pass_condition: No universal fit-for-purpose claim from one utility test.

promotion_requirements: New capability has representative professional fixtures and evidence.
